text: にんげんと　おなじように　ポケモンも　いきてるの！

structure.jp: にんげんと　おなじように
structure.en: in the same way as humans

patterns.name: 〜とおなじように
patterns.span: にんげんと　おなじように
patterns.explanation: と　おなじように after a word means 'in the same way as' that thing. にんげんと　おなじように = 'just like humans'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says a state is going on now; てる is the short spoken form. いきてる = 'are alive'.

patterns.name: 〜の (explaining)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a statement is a soft, feminine way of explaining something. いきてるの = 'they're alive, you know'.
